quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon join into one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves with several turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road will be slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for traffic only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Look for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and check for traffic in all directions before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any traffic or pedestrians to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead and shows the safe speed to drive (35 mph in this case). Slow down before the curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. You should slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance from the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A volunteer group is cleaning up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road work or maintenance is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road work or maintenance is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. These signs help drivers and pedestrians stay safe in dangerous zones. Traffic fines may be doubled in areas with these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers right ahead. This sign warns that you will have fewer lanes ahead and must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop and give the right-of-way. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is allowed with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn you about dangers ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at an intersection where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows you which direction traffic flows on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right, then curve to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about motorist services like rest areas, food, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the side shown by the arrow. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you continue.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
Detour to the right due to roadwork.
The road ahead curves sharply. Slow down.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves sharply. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp curve in this direction. Slow down as much as you would at a sharp turn in an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. What should you do?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that tells you the traffic rule. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with valid disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign above your lane mean?

options.text: You may not exit the freeway.
You may continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
You may stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane ends at an exit ramp. If you stay in this lane, you must exit the freeway. You can change lanes to continue on the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that pedestrians may be crossing ahead. Stop and wait if a pedestrian is in the crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a curve is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a roundabout is coming. Slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. It may mark a crosswalk where children or pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare to slow down or turn.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond-shaped sign warns you of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a winding road with three or more curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must obey. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if you see or hear one. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right, so be ready to let cars merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic to merge onto the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. You must come to a complete stop. Wait until it is safe and clear before you proceed through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns you about a winding road with many curves.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or with your turn signals. When you bend your left arm at the elbow and point downward, it means you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake problems or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let it merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction zones. This sign tells you that road work is coming up. Slow down and drive carefully through work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on slow-moving vehicles to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road curves right, then left.
The road curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign shows that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of people.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means there is a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You might see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past these signs, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians crossing in front of you pass. Stop if needed before going ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. Extending your left arm straight out to the left means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing where the ground is low. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of slippery road conditions. Wet pavement is dangerous and makes it harder to stop. Slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down when you see this sign and stop if needed. Stop at the marked line if one exists.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road is entering from the left.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a yield sign is ahead. Start slowing down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way highway and will soon drive on a two-way highway.

questions.question: What is your biggest concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not align properly because one side of your car is higher than the other.
A tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply to get back on the road. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell drivers to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and yield to other drivers or pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to yield when turning left at a green light. You must let oncoming traffic pass before completing your turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane for left turns only from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will change direction or get narrower. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or near narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to situations ahead that may not be obvious. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roadways with a divider between them. You must stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mean there is construction work ahead. Drive carefully and be ready for changes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of work zones. If you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert for unexpected conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. You must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to situations that may not be obvious. This sign warns that the right lane will end. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway will end. Be ready to change lanes or move your position.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane on the road will end soon. All traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road has low clearance above it.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic on this road goes one way only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic will merge onto your road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to areas where bicycles, animals, or pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit tell you?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road when conditions are good. You may need to drive slower in bad weather or poor road conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly use it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a side road will intersect with your road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that wet pavement is slippery and your vehicle may be hard to control.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells left-turning drivers they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (for example, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a roadway with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If it is safe and the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic in.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this red and white sign mean?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before going.
Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross.
Keep moving at the same speed and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic go first before you enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians have the right to go first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a lane is ending and traffic will merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic controls in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. It may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow, and black. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give extra space so drivers can merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your side and rear mirrors, then move to another lane if possible to let merging traffic through safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The speed limit is 35 mph after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph through the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before the curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards just ahead. A speed advisory plaque shows the safe speed for the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Look for pedestrians and other traffic before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road goes down steeply ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a side road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much vertical space is available under a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. It is illegal and unsafe to turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or be prepared for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turn is permitted.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right. Be aware and ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in or heading toward the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you may legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drive carefully because pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns you that you are approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are near a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign appears on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, be careful, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show which way the road curves. This sign points left, meaning the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs along the curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
You can go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not go forward. Turn around.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means "stop."

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always use your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A pentagon-shaped sign means a school zone or school crossing is nearby. When you see this sign, stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; the road curves ahead.
Slow down and do not use brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction sharply.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction sharply.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions right ahead. This sign warns you to slow down for a sharp change in the road's direction.

questions.question: This white sign means:

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep driving at your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Stop at the railroad tracks. Wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely. Stay alert when driving through intersections or turning. Children may be crossing.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road splits. You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road is splitting into two paths. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This sign tells a driver that:

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic safely through work zones.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully and be prepared.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians who may be crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black text. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers about traffic laws in the area. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads divided by a median or rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a sharp turn coming up and tells you to reduce speed.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop at a yield sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to possible hazards. This sign warns drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards right ahead. This sign warns that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a steep hill is coming and you should adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that railroad tracks are ahead. Slow down when you approach the crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before you cross the tracks.
